title: One install script sets up everything relay needs
what: A public install script (like the usual `curl ... | sh` installers) that checks for and installs what relay and its gate need: python3 3.11+, git, jq, uv, and the pinned gate tools (ruff, mypy) through uv; every download pinned to a version and checked by its published checksum; safe to run again; prints what it installed and what was already there.
why: Owner, verbatim: "Согласен, инструменты можно скачивать автоматически, обычно существуют публичные .sh скрипты для установки, мы тоже можем экспортировать такой с установкой всех необходимых зависимостей". The gate is getting tools beyond python3/jq/git (uv, mypy, ruff); a fresh Mac has python3 3.9 only.
